message.content:
Build GDPR features — customer DATA EXPORT and self-service ACCOUNT DELETION — for Nxeon at /opt/nxeon. Other agents edit OTHER areas concurrently — touch ONLY YOUR OWNED FILES.

## PRIMER
Next.js 15 + Prisma. `"use server"` = async-only. `import { db } from "@/lib/db"`; `import { requireUser, currentUser } from "@/lib/auth"`. Design: `.card`,`.input`,`.btn-danger`,`.btn-secondary`; `import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/primitives"`. The `User` relates to servers, walletTransactions, invoices, domains, tickets, sshKeys, projects, notifications, feedback, apiTokens, memberships, etc.

## TASK
1. **Data export** — `app/api/account/export/route.ts` (GET, `requireUser`/`currentUser`): returns a JSON download (`Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="nxeon-data-export.json"`) of the caller's own data — profile (no passwordHash/secrets), servers (no rootPassword), wallet transactions, invoices, domains, tickets, ssh keys, feedback, memberships. Never include other users' data or secret fields (passwordHash, rootPassword, totpSecret, anthropicKeyEnc, tokenHash).
2. **Account deletion** — `deleteMyAccount(confirmEmail)` in `lib/actions-gdpr.ts` (`"use server"`): requires the user to type their email to confirm; **refuses if the user has any non-deleted server** (they must delete servers first — return a clear message); otherwise deletes the User (cascading relations) and destroys the session. Audit-log the deletion (userId null + note) before deleting. Provide a helper `exportSummary(userId)` if useful for the UI.
3. **UI** — `components/customer/DangerZone.tsx` (`"use client"`): a "Privacy & data" card with a "Download my data" button (links to the export route) and a "Delete account" flow (type-email-to-confirm). Mount it by EDITING `app/dashboard/settings/page.tsx` (you are the sole editor this batch) — add a "Privacy & data" section at the bottom.

## OWNED FILES (create/edit ONLY these)
CREATE: `lib/actions-gdpr.ts`, `app/api/account/export/route.ts`, `components/customer/DangerZone.tsx`. EDIT (sole owner): `app/dashboard/settings/page.tsx`.

## HARD RULES
Never touch schema/next.config/layouts/Shell/lib/auth(read-only import)/db/rbac/worker/lib/actions.ts/ROADMAP/docs or others' files. No build/prisma/generate/restart/commit. No new deps. `"use server"` = async-only. Export/delete must be strictly scoped to the current user; never leak secrets.

## REPORT
Files created/edited; how export + deletion (with the has-servers guard) work; INTEGRATION NEEDED; risks (irreversibility of deletion — confirm the guard).

---SCHEMA---
generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

enum Role {
  CUSTOMER
  SUPPORT
  BILLING
  ADMIN
}

enum ServerStatus {
  PENDING
  PROVISIONING
  RUNNING
  STOPPED
  SUSPENDED
  REINSTALLING
  DELETING
  ERROR
}

enum JobStatus {
  QUEUED
  RUNNING
  DONE
  FAILED
}

enum JobType {
  PROVISION
  START
  STOP
  REBOOT
  REINSTALL
  DELETE
  SUSPEND
  UNSUSPEND
  RESIZE
  SNAPSHOT_CREATE
  SNAPSHOT_DELETE
  SNAPSHOT_ROLLBACK
  BACKUP_CREATE
  BACKUP_RESTORE
  SYNC_FORWARDS
  PASSWORD_RESET
  CLAUDE_BUILD
  GAME_UPDATE
}

enum TicketStatus {
  OPEN
  ANSWERED
  CUSTOMER_REPLY
  CLOSED
}

enum TicketPriority {
  LOW
  NORMAL
  HIGH
  URGENT
}

model User {
  id           String   @id @default(cuid())
  email        String   @unique
  passwordHash String
  name         String
  role         Role     @default(CUSTOMER)
  balanceCents Int      @default(0)
  suspended    Boolean  @default(false)
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now())
  servers      Server[]
  transactions WalletTransaction[]
  auditLogs    AuditLog[]
  projects     Project[]
  sshKeys      SshKey[]
  tickets      Ticket[]
  ticketMessages TicketMessage[]
  notifications Notification[]
  domains      Domain[]
  invoices     Invoice[]
  // Growth
  referralCode       String?  @unique
  referredById       String?
  referredBy         User?    @relation("Referrals", fields: [referredById], references: [id])
  referrals          User[]   @relation("Referrals")
  signupCreditCents  Int      @default(0)
  referralRewardedAt DateTime?
  couponRedemptions  CouponRedemption[]
  // Security
  totpSecret   String?
  totpEnabled  Boolean  @default(false)
  backupCodes  String[] @default([])
  apiTokens    ApiToken[]
  // Preferences
  notificationPrefs Json @default("{}")
  claudeBuilds ClaudeBuild[]
  anthropicKeyEnc String?   // BYOK: encrypted Anthropic API key
  feedback     Feedback[]
  // Teams
  ownedOrgs    Organization[] @relation("OrgOwner")
  memberships  Membership[]
  // Billing add-ons
  giftRedemptions      GiftCode[]
  autoRechargeEnabled  Boolean @default(false)
  autoRechargeThresholdCents Int?
  autoRechargeAmountCents    Int?
  stripeCustomerId     String?
  stripePaymentMethodId String?
}

model Project {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  name      String
  color     String   @default("#6f47f5")
  userId    String
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  servers   Server[]
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
}

model SshKey {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  name      String
  publicKey String
  userId    String
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
}

model Ticket {
  id        String         @id @default(cuid())
  subject   String
  status    TicketStatus   @default(OPEN)
  priority  TicketPriority @default(NORMAL)
  userId    String
  user      User           @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  messages  TicketMessage[]
  createdAt DateTime       @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime       @updatedAt
}

model TicketMessage {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  body      String
  isStaff   Boolean  @default(false)
  ticketId  String
  ticket    Ticket   @relation(fields: [ticketId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  authorId  String
  author    User     @relation(fields: [authorId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
}

enum DomainStatus {
  PENDING
  ACTIVE
  FAILED
  EXPIRED
}

model Domain {
  id           String       @id @default(cuid())
  name         String       @unique
  status       DomainStatus @default(PENDING)
  registrar    String       @default("namecheap")
  priceCents   Int          @default(0) // retail price the customer pays (per year)
  costCents    Int          @default(0) // registrar cost (per year)
  termYears    Int          @default(1)
  autoRenew    Boolean      @default(true)
  nameservers  String[]     @default([])
  transferEpp  String?      // EPP/auth code for outbound transfers
  whoisPrivacy Boolean      @default(true)
  registeredAt DateTime?
  expiresAt    DateTime?
  error        String?
  userId       String
  user         User         @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdAt    DateTime     @default(now())
}

model Notification {
  id        String    @id @default(cuid())
  title     String
  body      String?
  href      String?
  readAt    DateTime?
  userId    String
  user      User      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now())
}

model Plan {
  id            String   @id @default(cuid())
  slug          String   @unique
  name          String
  cpuCores      Int
  ramMB         Int
  diskGB        Int
  bandwidthTB   Float    @default(1)
  priceCents    Int
  storageTier   String   @default("nvme") // "nvme" | "hdd"
  active        Boolean  @default(true)
  sortOrder     Int      @default(0)
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now())
  servers       Server[]
  gamePlans     GamePlan[]
}

enum ImageCategory {
  PLAIN_OS
  CONTROL_PANEL
  APPLICATION
}

/// An installable image shown in the deploy wizard. Plain OS clones `baseVmid`
/// directly; control panels / apps clone `baseVmid` then run `setupScript`
/// (cloud-init runcmd) to install the panel/app on first boot.
model OsTemplate {
  id            String        @id @default(cuid())
  slug          String        @unique
  name          String        // display name, e.g. "Ubuntu"
  category      ImageCategory @default(PLAIN_OS)
  family        String        @default("linux") // ubuntu | debian | almalinux | rocky | cpanel | ...
  version       String        @default("")      // "24.04", "13", ""
  logo          String        @default("")      // icon slug for the UI
  vmid          Int           // legacy/base template VMID to clone
  baseVmid      Int?          // explicit base OS template for panels/apps (falls back to vmid)
  setupScript   String?       // shell installed via cloud-init runcmd (panels/apps)
  minRamMB      Int           @default(1024)
  minDiskGB     Int           @default(10)
  licenseRequired Boolean     @default(false)   // e.g. cPanel/Plesk need a paid license
  featured      Boolean       @default(false)
  sortOrder     Int           @default(0)
  active        Boolean       @default(true)
  servers       Server[]
}

model Server {
  id            String       @id @default(cuid())
  name          String
  label         String?      // customer-facing nickname (rename)
  hostname      String
  vmid          Int?         @unique

No type errors in my files. All done.

## Report

Built the two GDPR features for Nxeon, strictly scoped to the current user, secrets never exposed.

### Files created
- `/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-gdpr.ts` — `"use server"`; exports `deleteMyAccount(confirmEmail)` and helper `exportSummary(userId)`.
- `/opt/nxeon/app/api/account/export/route.ts` — GET JSON export download.
- `/opt/nxeon/components/customer/DangerZone.tsx` — `"use client"` "Privacy & data" card.

### Files edited (sole owner)
- `/opt/nxeon/app/dashboard/settings/page.tsx` — imported `DangerZone`, mounted `<DangerZone email={user.email} />` as the last section.

### How export works
GET `/api/account/export` uses `currentUser()` (401 if unauthenticated), returns `Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="nxeon-data-export.json"`, `Cache-Control: private, no-store`. Every query is filtered by `userId: user.id`. Includes profile, servers, wallet transactions, invoices, domains, tickets (+messages), ssh keys, feedback, memberships. Explicit `select`s exclude all secrets: `rootPassword` (servers), `transferEpp` (domain auth code), and profile omits `passwordHash`, `totpSecret`, `backupCodes`, `anthropicKeyEnc`, Stripe ids. A `jsonReplacer` converts Prisma `BigInt` columns (server bandwidth) to strings so serialization can't throw.

### How deletion + the has-servers guard work
`deleteMyAccount(confirmEmail)`: requires `requireUser`, the typed email must match `user.email` (case-insensitive). Guard: refuses if any server with `status != "DELETING"` exists (that's the "non-deleted server" definition used throughout the codebase — servers are soft-marked `DELETING` then reaped by the worker), returning a clear "delete your servers first" message. On pass, a single `$transaction`:
1. Writes the audit log (`userId: null`, action `user.account_deleted`) **before** deleting.
2. Handles relations that lack `onDelete: Cascade` in the schema (these would otherwise FK-block the delete): anonymizes the user's remaining `AuditLog` rows to `userId: null`, null-outs `referredById` on anyone they referred, deletes `WalletTransaction`s, deletes `Server`s (only DELETING rows remain post-guard; cascades their jobs/port-forwards/dedicated-IPs/claude-builds), and clears `PasswordResetToken`s.
3. `user.delete` cascades the rest (projects, ssh keys, tickets, notifications, domains, invoices, api tokens, memberships, owned orgs, coupon redemptions; feedback & gift codes are set-null by schema).
Then `destroySession()` and `redirect("/")`.

I verified the full User FK graph: every relation is cascade, set-null, or handled manually above — no orphan FK will block the delete.

### Integration needed
None beyond this batch — the section is already mounted at the bottom of the settings page. No new deps, no schema/build/migration changes.

### Risks
- Deletion is irreversible. Double-gated by type-exact-email confirmation (client disables the button until it matches, and the server re-validates) plus the active-server guard, so it can't fire accidentally or leave a live VM billing an orphaned account.
- The guard treats `DELETING`-status servers as already-gone and hard-deletes their DB rows in the transaction. If the worker is still mid-teardown on Proxmox when the account is deleted, that teardown job loses its DB row — a possible orphaned VM on the node. Acceptable per the task's "non-deleted server" definition, but flagging it.
- I did not run a build/prisma/generate/restart (per hard rules); I only ran `tsc --noEmit`, which reported no errors in the owned files.
